S.FORM: alang Libu ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Nahuy go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 27 buwan, 103 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 99 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 4 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 93%, Bunun 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Libu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Libu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Libu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Libu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Libu hya' ga Llyung. tay 'llaw na Libu hya' ga Batul. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ liβu ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu naħuj ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na liβu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na liβu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na liβu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na liβu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na liβu ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔllaw na liβu ħjaʔ ɣa βatul reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
